rows.body: schemes, launches, the plan that scales. small and finished keeps losing to huge and hypothetical, and the huge hypotheticals have a suspiciously low completion rate.
self_questions: what small finished thing did you skip for a big imaginary one?

rows.title: commitment as craft
rows.body: you treat promises like load bearing beams. your word, once given, gets maintained like infrastructure, inspected and kept true for years. people build on it because it holds.
self_questions: what promise have you maintained the longest?

rows.title: the slow yes
rows.body: you commit carefully because you commit completely. people mistake your hesitation for coldness. it's the opposite. you're checking whether you can afford another forever.
self_questions: what are you circling right now, deciding whether to promise?

rows.title: the collection
rows.body: all those scraps of knowing add up to something. the trivia, the half-skills, the things you picked up once and never forgot. one day two random pieces click together and that's the whole trick. your breadth is the asset.
self_questions: what two unrelated things you know have ever clicked together?

rows.title: the routine is the medicine
rows.body: your mood holds when the routine holds. sleep, meals, the walk, the list. skip three days of the structure and the feelings start to wobble. boring saves you, reliably.
self_questions: which routine is actually load bearing?

rows.title: the group's fist
rows.body: you fight for collectives. the team, the community, the users, the future. personal battles bore you, but touch the group and your whole detachment reverses instantly.
self_questions: which group gets your fist?

rows.title: the vanishing act
rows.body: you disappear on people. days of quiet, plans that dissolve, messages left on read while you're somewhere unreachable inside yourself. the ones who love you either learned your tides or they left on one.
self_questions: who's learned to wait out your disappearances?

rows.title: to your face
rows.body: you confront in person, in daylight, on the record. fighting behind backs disgusts you at a physical level. whatever you have to say about someone, they've already heard it first.
self_questions: when did saying it straight cost you, and was it still right?

rows.title: you love loudly
rows.body: when you love someone, everybody knows. you brag about your people, celebrate their smallest wins, show up like a parade. subtlety was never the plan. your love has a volume knob and it's broken at high.
self_questions: who have you been bragging about lately?

rows.title: the translator between people
rows.body: you hear what each side actually means and reissue it in words the other side can receive. half the arguments you've been near were resolved by your rephrasing. neither party ever fully clocks that it was you.
self_questions: which two people do you translate between?

rows.title: the just weight
rows.body: saturn does its best work in your sign, and it made you the judge. fairness is a discipline for you, commitment a serious contract, relationships things you build to code. you were never casual about the scales, and everyone who's ever dealt with you knows it.
self_questions: who trusts your fairness above everyone else's?

rows.title: you beautify by presence
rows.body: rooms compose themselves better with you in them. gatherings, dinners, whole lives get more lovely at your touch, and you do it so lightly nobody catches the artist at work. it's a real contribution, not a garnish.
self_questions: what have you quietly made more beautiful?

rows.title: belief steadies the heart
rows.body: your moods need something bigger to lean on. a faith, a philosophy, a practice, a way of seeing it all. when the framework is strong, the hard days are survivable. when it cracks, everything does.
self_questions: what do you lean on that's bigger than you?

rows.title: loneliest at the party
rows.body: you can be at the center of the noise, playing your part perfectly, and feel like you're hearing it all from another room. the crowd never notices. the drum keeps time regardless.
self_questions: who would notice if you went quiet?

rows.title: quick to flare, quicker to forgive
rows.body: your anger is real but it's brief. ten minutes later you're fine and confused why the other person is still upset. the flare looks scarier than it is. the people who know you know to just let it pass.
self_questions: who understands that your anger is a storm, not a season?

rows.title: chaos dims the light
rows.body: instability, constant flux, ground that won't stop moving. your radiance needs footing, and long unsettled seasons grey you in a way tiredness never could.
self_questions: what unsettled thing is costing you light?
